info.name: TmsIntern API
description: Hand-documented Postman collection for the TmsIntern platform, built
from version-controlled fragments under `postman/build/fragments`. Rebuild it
Auth uses **Laravel Sanctum** with two token abilities:
- `access` — used by virtually every protected endpoint.
The collection default auth is **Bearer `{{access_token}}`**, so protected
requests inherit it automatically. Public requests override this with *No Auth*.
`Verify OTP` and `Refresh access token` include test scripts that
capture the returned tokens into the `{{access_token}}` / `{{refresh_token}}`
collection variables, so you can log in once and then call protected endpoints.
| `lang` | Sent as the `lang` header (`ar` or `en`). Defaults to `ar`. |
